messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to tirzepatide, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in tirzepatide.
There is a list of ingredients in tirzepatide, at the bottom of this page.
Tell your healthcare team if you are planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation.
Tell your doctor if you have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease, a history of diabetic retinopathy or any stomach problems such as difficulty digesting food.
Tell your doctor if you plan to become pregnant, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding.
If you become pregnant while taking tirzepatide, you should tell your doctor.
There is a pregnancy exposure registry for women who take Zepbound during pregnancy.
Talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part.
Call 1-844-524-0039.
Visit https://pregnancyregistry.lilly.com/zepbound.
Triplet: ["tirzepatide", "has allergy information", "allergic to other medications"]

The relation 'has allergy information' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires patients to be aware of or inform their healthcare provider about the specific allergic reaction or sensitivity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'has clinical importance': The subject drug has a clinically significant characteristic or requirement specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
